description: This file defines the 'Shipping' controller class for the OpenCart admin extension, managing shipping extensions including listing, installation, and uninstallation.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping extensions within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point to display the list of shipping extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the list of available and installed shipping extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a shipping extension, including permission setup and registering extension components.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for a shipping extension, including permission revocation.
